prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that Beijing-to-Shanghai sprint last year—everything felt like a blur between the two cities.
Funny thing is, I also ended up taking a train on that same Beijing to Shanghai route at one point, just to compare how it felt.
And in the middle of all that, I had a quick detour in Hangzhou—such a pretty city when the weather cooperates.
Once I finally got settled in Shanghai, I remember chatting with neighbors about home services there—everyone had a different recommendation.
My coworker Wang Fang had a flight booked for 2025-03-23—flight MU5890, and it was with China Eastern if I’m remembering right.
Yeah, and I’m pretty sure the airline on that one was China Eastern—she kept mentioning how the timing worked out perfectly.
For Hangzhou, my friend Li Na stayed at the Hilton Hangzhou West Lake—checked in on 2025-03-11 and just kept raving about the lake view.
She was there for 4 nights, which honestly sounded like the right amount of time—long enough to unwind but not too long.

Oh, and Chen Ming told me he rode train D321 on 2025-03-11—Second Class—and later he even mentioned booking a morning home-service visit on 2025-03-19 to Room 801, Building A, North Apartment, with the contact number 13822970109.
